description: tests/test-prop27-monetization-cta-link.sh (the ONLY oracle for REQ-27) exercises exclusively AUTONOMY=off (Mode A) in all 4 of its sub-scenarios (lines 18-19, 28-29, 40-41, 50-51 all set AUTONOMY=off). There is zero assertion anywhere in the test suite that the Mode-B (AUTONOMY=on) published artifact actually contains the monetization link. This is precisely why FIND-001 (the CTA link never reaching Mode B's real published content) went undetected -- the test claims '8/8 assertions PASS' (SKILL.md:157) but structurally cannot catch the Mode-B disconnect because it never runs a Mode-B scenario. A test asserting cta_url is recorded to STATE.md for a Mode-B PUBLISHED/UNCONFIRMED outcome (which run.sh does do, e.g. run.sh:479/494) would still pass even though the underlying note.com article body never received the link -- this is a textbook 'test that would pass even if a critical edge case were unhandled'.

evidence.snippet: ARTICLE_TEST=1 ARTICLE_DIR="$T1" AUTONOMY=off ... (repeated for all 4 sub-tests; AUTONOMY=on never appears in this file)
